history.zh: 2026-10-12 P83：静止之步由 P83 给出（identification-where-bounded）：轨道被长 N 的列表所持时，学习者从第 N + (2N − 1)·tri N 步起每步主张且正确（Identification.held_learner_rests，经 Identification.unrefuted_persists：N 之内的套索假设在 2N − 1 步中不被否证就永不被否证）；这里的双重否定陈述不变，未检查草图的说法改为这一定理；见整合文档 §{S}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P83: the step of rest is stated by P83 (identification-where-bounded): where the orbit is held by a list of length N, the learner claims and is right at every step from N + (2N − 1)·tri N on (Identification.held_learner_rests, through Identification.unrefuted_persists: a lasso hypothesis within N unrefuted for 2N − 1 steps is never refuted again); the double-negation statements here are unchanged, and the mention of an unchecked sketch is replaced by that theorem; see §{S} of the integration note. history.en: 2026-10-12 P83: beyond the learning clause's coming to rest being unrefuted (held_rest_unrefuted), P83 states the step of rest: where the orbit is held by a list of length N, the learner by refutation claims and is right at every step from N + (2N − 1)·tri N on, a function of the list's length, which the learner does not have (Identification.held_learner_rests, identification-where-bounded); see §{S} of the integration note. The claim is unchanged.
